biotools.summary: cncFinder is a graph-attention-network-based web tool that identifies bifunctional long non-coding RNAs by transforming lncRNA sequences into k-mer graphs with Word2Vec-encoded node features, providing interpretable predictions validated on human, mouse, and fruit fly data.
